advisory.finding: store_status()'s docstring says 'Never raises', but when the retired TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR tombstone env is set, tracker_dir_override() raises RemovedInputError (a BaseException) which is deliberately re-raised out of store_status() and the /health route, producing a 500. Under compose `restart: always` + a HEALTHCHECK on /health, this turns one input class into exactly the container crash-loop the probe design otherwise avoids — and directly contradicts the same function's rationale that 'a health probe must not be able to fail (or block) on config parsing'.
scenarios: A deployment still exporting the tombstone env TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR: /health raises 500, HEALTHCHECK fails, restart: always crash-loops the container.

advisory.finding: test_boot_sweep_is_quiet_and_does_not_raise_when_the_store_exists asserts only the ABSENCE of the missing-store warning, with no liveness anchor that the present-store branch actually executed. run_startup_store_sweep with a present dir calls _ensures.run_ensures(tracker, ...), and any exception there is swallowed by 'except Exception: logging...debug(...)' — so the warning is absent both when the present-store path ran correctly AND when run_ensures raised before the branch mattered. The check cannot distinguish its pass verdict from a sweep that errored out.
scenarios: A future bug makes run_ensures raise for a present store; the warning would still be absent so the test stays green, and a regression that mis-warns on a present store could be masked if it raised earlier.
advisory.suggested_fix: monkeypatch _ensures.run_ensures to a spy, assert it was called with str(present), then assert no missing-store warning was emitted.

blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 153 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug d9ab-7b5e-fe4c-4ff4 has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix like this is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan d9ab-7b5e-fe4c-4ff4` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review d9ab-7b5e-fe4c-4ff4` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan d9ab-7b5e-fe4c-4ff4 --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.

dropped.finding: The autodeploy step-5b store gate fails OPEN on any failure to obtain or parse /health: the python one-liner catches all exceptions to `st = {}` and prints 'ok', and the pipeline is further guarded by `|| echo ok`. A working container whose /health emits non-JSON (or whose curl transiently fails at 5b despite passing step 5) is promoted silently — the gate cannot distinguish 'checked, store present' from 'the store check never produced a usable verdict'.
scenarios: A container serves a broken /health that returns non-JSON but 200 at step 5, or a transient curl failure at 5b: the gate reports 'ok' and promotes.
